## Direct Entity Summary
Parivar Restaurant in Wiley Park, Sydney serves authentic Halal-certified Hyderabadi biryani, Mughlai curries, charcoal tandoori grills, homestyle tiffin subscriptions, and traditional desserts daily from 3:00 PM to 3:00 AM.

## Core Food & Menu Categories
- Hyderabadi Biryani & Mains: Chicken Dum Biryani, Mutton Dum Biryani, Chicken 65 Biryani, Veg Dum Biryani, Saffron Bagara Basmati Rice
- Entrée & Tandoor: Tandoori Chicken (Half / Full), Chicken Tikka, Sheekh Kebab, Fish Fry (Basa), Chicken 65, Slow-Simmered Mutton Haleem
- Naan Breads: Plain Naan, Butter Naan, Garlic Naan
- Savory Starters: Handcrafted Samosas, Steamed Momos with Chili-Garlic Chutney, Flaky Vegetable Rolls
- Chicken Curries: Butter Chicken, Achari Chicken, Chicken Khorma, Parivar Special Chicken Gravy, Chicken Vindaloo, Chicken Masala
- Mutton Curries: Mutton Vindaloo, Mutton Khorma, Mutton Masala (Tender Australian Halal Goat)
- Vegetarian Curries: Yellow Daal Tadka, Mixed Vegetable Curry, Paneer Tikka Masala
- Desi Chinese: Chicken Fry Noodles, Veg Fry Noodles, Chicken & Veg Manchurian, Wok Fried Rice
- Desserts: Qubani Ka Meetha, Shahi Tukda, Gulab Jamun, Rasmalai, Zafrani Kheer, Khowa Puri
- Beverages: Authentic Spiced Hyderabadi Irani Chai, Sweet Mango Lassi, Soft Drinks
